[size=3]Work with StardewValley v1.4+

[color=#ffff00]v 3.0.3[/color]
-Quality Support
[color=#efefef]-[/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063][color=#e69138]Automate[/color] [/url]and [color=#00ffff][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5038]PFM-Automate patch[/url][/color] optimizations. (You need both files for PFM Machines)([color=#f1c232]Optional[/color])
[b]-This mod is now a Dependency of "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5678]Mineral Mage[/url]" mod. ([color=#00ff00]If you love shinies and magic, go check it out![/color])[/b]

[color=#ffff00]v 3.0.2[/color]
Conversion to [PFM]
[color=#ffff00]If you have a previous version, Delete this 4 folders :[/color]
-[CFR] JewelcraftingMachines
-[CFR] EnchantingTable
-[CFR] FabergeBench
-[JA] Jewelcrafting

Custom Farming Redux is no longer needed.



[color=#f1c232]More Balance:[/color]
Reduced prices/crafting requirements and production times.
Tried a solo miner gameplay and it felt a bit slow... so i hope this makes things more fluid.
[/size]
[color=#ffff00][size=3]V 1.5.1  Fixed some loose lines[/size][/color]
[color=#ffff00][size=4]V 1.5     Balance patch[/size][/color]
[size=3]This mod was designed to boost the Mining productivity and make it competitive to his farming counterpart.[/size]
[size=3]Till 1.4 this mod was doing Ok...   but farming can still overprofit this jewel making activity. So[/size]

[color=#00ff00][size=3]+ I reduced the material costs of the 3 machines and greatly reduce their buying price at clint´s.[/size][/color]

[size=3]Prismatic Shards are very hard to come by...  some people may just want to collect all the Enchanted Faberges.[/size]
[size=3]But for users who want to make profit , there is not so much in the end product... (just Ok)[/size]

[color=#00ff00][size=3]+ So i inceased the selling price of most Enchanted faberges in 200 to 800  gold.[/size][/color]


Fixed 2 typos... 
the [color=#d5a6bd]Amethyst [/color]item folders will still have the typos.. but the description is fixed.
If i "Fix" the folder names.. then people who download a fixed version will have "Duplicate items" and the game will crash or will omit the whole mod.
Folder item names hurts nobody... They still work inside perfectly.... [color=#ff0000] let[/color][color=#ff7700] them[/color] [color=#ffff00]be[/color] [color=#00ff00]who[/color] [color=#00ffff]they[/color] [color=#ff00ff]are[/color]... ;) 



[color=#ffff00][size=4]Screenshots added! (at the end)[/size][/color]
[color=#ffff00]V 1.4        [/color][size=3]
+added 100+ more faberge eggs /normal and enchanted
+fixed Golden bar egg requiring an amethist
/Remember to merge the"Mods" folder of this file into your"Mods"folder



[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/1861/1861-1518755797-1712701756.png[/img]

[color=#ffff00]v 1.3[/color]
+Enchantments for the Faberge eggs
+Logistic files.

[/size][size=4][color=#ffff00] v1.2[/color]
[color=#d8d8d8]+New Faberge crafting station
+7 types of faberge eggs [/color]

[color=#ffff00]V1.1[/color]
[/size][size=3]+Enchanting table now enchat jewelry instead of making it[/size]

------------
[color=#93c47d][size=5]Usage:[/size][/color]
[size=3]You can buy/craft 3 new CraftingStations The [color=#ff7700]Jewelcrafting table[/color] , [color=#00ffff]Enchanting table [/color][color=#d8d8d8]and the [/color][color=#ffd966]Faberge Bench.[/color][/size]
[size=3]And you can input :[/size]

[color=#ffffff]Main Reagent Jewel:[/color]
[size=3]-Emerald[/size]
[size=3]-Ruby[/size]
[size=3]-Topaz[/size]
[size=3]-Aquamarine[/size]
[size=3]-Amethyst[/size]
[size=3]-Diamond[/size]
[color=#ffff00](all the jewels minus Jade)[/color]

[color=#bf9000]Default[/color][size=3] :[/size]
[size=3]-Gold Bars[/size]
[size=3]-Refined Quartz [/size]
[color=#ffff00](Taken from inventory Automatically)[/color]

[size=3]The "[/size][color=#ff7700]Jewelcrafting table[/color][size=3]" yield jewelry in the span of 5-10 days[/size]
[size=3]And just 1 day for the [color=#00ffff]Enchanting Table[/color].[/size]

[size=3]The [/size][color=#00ffff][size=3]Enchanting table[/size][/color][size=3] have an incresed value of +30%. And a 100% for the faberge eggs [color=#ffff00](new)[/color][/size]
[size=3]With +1 crafting day per jewel and the extra requirement of a[color=#c27ba0] Refined Quartz[/color].[/size]
[size=3]+(you need to input an Un-enchanted piece of jewelry) [/size][size=3]updated![/size]
[size=5]
[color=#cccccc]------[/color]
[color=#ffff00]Faberge Bench[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#d8d8d8]You can make Faberge eggs out of Golden bars and any egg (Dinosaur egg too)[/color]
[color=#d8d8d8]input any jewel (or a golden bar for a golden egg)
[/color]You can input any mineral (but ores)    ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿[color=#ffff00] ﻿( New)[/color]

[color=#d8d8d8]Resulting eggs will be "Artisan Goods" and, for now, they can now be enchanted!. [/color][color=#ffff00](new)[/color]
[color=#d8d8d8]In comparison with normal jewerly, Faberge eggs have an incresed +200gold fixed amount[/color]
[color=#d8d8d8]and need a little bit longer to be completed and 14 days to be enchanted.[/color]
[color=#d8d8d8]They are good for display show, gifts and profit.[/color]
[/size]
-----------

[size=3]Jewerly and Faberge eggs are labeled under the cathegory "[/size][color=#d5a6bd][size=3]Artisan Goods[/size][/color][size=3]" so[/size]
[size=3]It can be affected by the [/size][color=#ff7700]Artistan Skill[/color][size=3]..  adding +40% more sell value.
+Also! Villagers say they like them (as gifts).[/size]
[size=3]if you cant find the crafting reagents or you dont want to craft the stations, you can go to [/size][color=#dd7e6b]Clint´s Shop[/color][size=3]. He will sell you both for quite an amount...[/size]
-----------------------------------

[color=#00ff00][size=5]Balance[/size][/color]
[size=3]In Real life, the price of jewelry is +200% to +700% of the value of the components.
I used a value of +%240% (Aprox) of the vanilla prices.
The values taking in consideration were : The Default gold bar needed (250G) + (JewelValue) *2.4

The Range of earnings are 800 to 2000 after 5 -10 days of crafting.
And i based it on the time it takes for a keg to produce an Ancient Fruit Wine ..  7 days with a value of 1600.

The enchanting table add more value (30%), but it need a bit more time (+1day) and 1 extra reagent (Refined Quartz)

Even if it look easy to make profit with it.. you still need to :
-Craft/buy the Workstations
-Get the gold ores and smelt them into Bars (4 ingame hours)
-Get jewels
-Get Quartz and smelt them (1.2 ingame hours)
-Wait till produce. (5 - 11  ingame days)
-Get eggs
-Find Prismatic shards.

So i think it have what it takes to be a common mechanic without being OP.
time will tell..

[/size]
---------------
[size=5][color=#ff00ff]Known bugs.    [/color][color=#ffff00] MOSTLY for Custom Farming Redux - (This mod is PFM now)[/color][/size]
[size=3]1.When you input a jewel to a crafting station, and it was the last of the stack, The inventory shift 1 space by row.
It doesnt delete anything and dont seem to be harmful...

2. This may be a bug for all the CustomFarmingRedux machines. : If you use the pickaxe to destroy a crafting station while procesing materials, the droped item cant be used again for crafting.     [color=#ffff00]Upadate!:[/color]  It seems its a Vanilla SDV bug and not a CFR.

3. Items may become invisible after updating...    (This is a JA bug)
You may want to trash/sell them and get new ones...   (Sorry, no other walk around at this time)[/size]
----------
[size=4][color=#1e84cc]Mod Conflicts.[/color]
1.This mod call the items by their name, instead of their id/index.
So it [color=#ffff00]MAY[/color] conflict with another mod who has the same item names. 
(I made the names unique enough to avoid this) (also, i dont see more jewel based mods on nexus for sdv)[/size]
--------
[size=4][color=#00ff00]Fun Fact:[/color]
Did you know that you can put items over furniture tables and endtables for show?
more than 1,000 hours in the game, and i just found that...  I born again![/size]
--------[size=4]
Have fun!

Made by Undare.
 (Thanks to Smapi Creator and the wonderful JsonAssets Team!)[/size]
